# `conversation` operations

The exact fields each `conversation.*` operation takes and returns.

<!-- Generated by `python scripts/codegen/docs_reference.py` from the op registry; edit the models, not this page. -->

Every op is `POST /v1/<op>` over HTTP and the MCP tool `loom_<op>`. The identity fields (`org`, `namespace`, `agent`, `user_id`, `session_id`) are filled from the token and the MCP session when a transport can; see [identities and namespaces](../../concepts/identities-and-namespaces.md). The [operations index](../operations.md) explains role, kind and the MCP `all` listing. Unknown input fields are served and named in `ignored_args`.

<!-- prettier-ignore-start -->

## `conversation.append`

Log one chat turn (role + content) to the active thread.

`POST /v1/conversation.append` · MCP `loom_conversation_append` · role `writer` · idempotent

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `agent` | `str` | required | The writing or reading agent; `'-'` or `'*'` means any agent where the op allows it. |
| `thread_id` | `str` | required | The thread to append to; it need not have been created first. |
| `msg_id` | `str` | `''` | optional; server derives a content hash when omitted |
| `role` | `Literal['user', 'assistant', 'system', 'tool']` | required | Who spoke: `user`, `assistant`, `system` or `tool`. |
| `content` | `str` | required | The message text, stored verbatim; a user or assistant turn is also embedded for `conversation.search`, unless its text reads as high. |
| `reasoning` | `str` | `''` | The model's reasoning for this turn, stored beside `content`; empty = none. |
| `user_id` | `str` | `'-'` | The end user the row belongs to; `'-'` for none. |
| `run_id` | `str` | `'-'` | The agent run (task scope) the call belongs to; `'-'` for none. |
| `metadata` | `dict[str, Any]` | *(computed)* | Free-form JSON stored on the message; read back by `get` and `list`. |
| `tokens` | `int` | `0` | Token count the caller reports for the message, stored as given; 0 = not reported. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `msg_id` | `str` | The message id: the one sent, or the content hash the server derived. |
| `ts` | `datetime` | Server time of this call; the message's timestamp when it was written. |
| `stored` | `bool` | False when recording is off or the turn was removed while embedding ran. |
| `reason` | `Literal['', 'duplicate', 'logging_disabled', 'deleted']` | "" (written), "duplicate" (this msg_id already landed; stored=True), "logging_disabled" or "deleted" (stored=False). |

## `conversation.compact`

Summarize old turns into one embedded system turn and tombstone the originals.

`POST /v1/conversation.compact` · MCP `loom_conversation_compact` · role `writer` · idempotent · audited · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `agent` | `str` | required | The writing or reading agent; `'-'` or `'*'` means any agent where the op allows it. |
| `thread_id` | `str` | required | The thread to compact. |
| `keep_recent` | `int` | `10` | The newest this many messages stay verbatim; older ones are summarized, as many as fit the summarizer's prompt. |
| `min_to_compact` | `int` | `4` | Skip when fewer new turns than this precede the last keep_recent; an earlier summary does not count. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `compacted` | `bool` | True when a summary was written and the originals tombstoned; `reason` says why not. |
| `messages_summarized` | `int` | How many older messages the summary replaced, not counting an earlier summary; 0 when not compacted. |
| `summary_msg_id` | `str` | Id of the synthetic `system` summary message; empty when not compacted. |
| `tokens_in` | `int` | Prompt tokens the summarizer LLM call used; 0 when no call was made. |
| `tokens_out` | `int` | Completion tokens of the summary; 0 when no call was made. |
| `reason` | `str` | Why compacted=False: nothing-to-compact, below-min-to-compact, already-compacted, summarizer-empty, embed-failed (retry once the embedder answers), summary-high-sensitivity (do not retry: the same window gets the same summary). |

## `conversation.create`

Open a thread container.

`POST /v1/conversation.create` · MCP `loom_conversation_create` · role `writer` · idempotent · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `agent` | `str` | required | The writing or reading agent; `'-'` or `'*'` means any agent where the op allows it. |
| `thread_id` | `str` | required | The caller's id for the thread; re-creating the same id replaces its title, metadata and `run_id`. |
| `title` | `str` | `''` | Display title shown in thread lists; empty = untitled. |
| `metadata` | `dict[str, Any]` | *(computed)* | Free-form JSON stored on the thread row; `conversation.get` returns it. |
| `run_id` | `str` | `'-'` | The agent run (task scope) the call belongs to; `'-'` for none. |
| `user_id` | `str` | `'-'` | The end user the row belongs to; `'-'` for none. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `thread_id` | `str` | Echo of the input `thread_id`. |
| `created_at` | `datetime` | When this call wrote the thread row. |

## `conversation.delete`

Soft-delete one thread: its messages, thread row and embeddings no other agent holds.

`POST /v1/conversation.delete` · MCP `loom_conversation_delete` · role `admin` · idempotent · audited · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `agent` | `str` | required | The writing or reading agent; `'-'` or `'*'` means any agent where the op allows it. |
| `thread_id` | `str` | required | The thread to soft-delete. |
| `confirm_thread_id` | `str` | required | Must equal `thread_id`, or the call fails with 400 and nothing is deleted. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tombstoned_at` | `datetime` | The tombstone time stamped on every affected row. |
| `thread_id` | `str` | Echo of the input `thread_id`. |
| `rows_affected` | `dict[str, int]` | {table_name: rows tombstoned}; for loom.conversation_embeddings, turns (one per turn however many embedding models hold it). |
| `total` | `int` | Sum of `rows_affected` across tables. |

## `conversation.get`

Fetch one thread by id: thread metadata + optional messages.

`POST /v1/conversation.get` · MCP `loom_conversation_get` · role `viewer` · read · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `agent` | `str` | required | "*" or "-" reads every agent's turns in the thread (a turn two agents both logged once), for a caller that has only its id, as conversation.search reads "*" and "-"; any other value reads that one agent's. |
| `thread_id` | `str` | required | The thread to fetch. |
| `include_messages` | `bool` | `False` | Default off: keeps the metadata lookup to two point reads. |
| `limit` | `int` | `100` | At most this many messages when `include_messages` is set (1-1000). |
| `offset` | `int` | `0` | Messages to skip from the end `order` counts from. |
| `order` | `Literal['asc', 'desc']` | `'asc'` | Which end of the thread the page is counted from. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `found` | `bool` | False when the thread has neither a thread row nor any live message. |
| `thread_id` | `str` | Echo of the input `thread_id`. |
| `title` | `str` | Title from `conversation.create` or `update`; empty when none was set. |
| `metadata` | `dict[str, Any]` | Thread metadata JSON; `{}` when none was set, apart from the titler's `title_refused` mark. |
| `run_id` | `str` | The agent run (task scope) the call belongs to; `'-'` for none. |
| `user_id` | `str` | The end user the row belongs to; `'-'` for none. |
| `agent` | `str` | The thread's owner (the agent of its thread row); for a thread built by appends only, the latest writer among the messages read, so empty without `include_messages`. |
| `created_at` | `datetime \| None` | When the thread row was first written; None for a thread built by appends only. |
| `updated_at` | `datetime \| None` | When the thread row last changed; None for a thread built by appends only. |
| `msg_count` | `int` | Live (not tombstoned) messages in the thread, returned even without messages. |
| `messages` | `list[_ConversationEntry]` | Populated only when include_messages=True; simple limit/offset slicing (cursor-paginated walks belong on conversation.list). |
| `next_cursor` | `str \| None` | With `order="asc"`, the `conversation.list` cursor for the turns after this page; None when the page reaches the end, or the order is `desc`. |

## `conversation.list`

Enumerate stored conversation threads for an agent / namespace.

`POST /v1/conversation.list` · MCP `loom_conversation_list` · role `viewer` · read · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `agent` | `str` | required | "*" or "-" reads every agent's turns in the thread (a turn two agents both logged once), for a caller that has only its id, as conversation.search reads "*" and "-"; any other value reads that one agent's. |
| `thread_id` | `str` | required | The thread to page through, oldest message first. |
| `run_id` | `str \| None` | `None` | optional filter; None or "-" = every run |
| `limit` | `int` | `100` | At most this many messages per page (1-1000). |
| `cursor` | `str \| None` | `None` | opaque (ts, msg_id) |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rows` | `list[_ConversationEntry]` | The page of messages in chronological order. |
| `next_cursor` | `str \| None` | Pass as `cursor` for the next page; None when this is the last page. |

## `conversation.list_saved_messages`

Page through the messages a user saved, newest first, with no query: the first view of a "Saved" panel before anything is typed.

`POST /v1/conversation.list_saved_messages` · MCP `loom_conversation_list_saved_messages` · role `viewer` · read · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `agent` | `str` | required | The writing or reading agent; `'-'` or `'*'` means any agent where the op allows it. |
| `user_id` | `str` | required | Only this user's saved messages are listed. |
| `conversation_id` | `str \| None` | `None` | Optional: only the messages saved from one conversation. |
| `limit` | `int` | `50` | At most this many messages per page (1-200). |
| `cursor` | `str \| None` | `None` | Opaque; pass the previous page's `next_cursor`. |
| `fields` | `list[str] \| None` | `None` | The output fields the caller reads (a whitelist resolved against the row model; an unknown name is a 422); unset, every field. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rows` | `list[_SavedMessageHit]` | The page, most recently saved first. |
| `next_cursor` | `str \| None` | Pass as `cursor` for the next page; None when this is the last page. |

## `conversation.save_message`

Save one chat message a user picked for search, whether or not the namespace records transcripts.

`POST /v1/conversation.save_message` · MCP `loom_conversation_save_message` · role `writer` · idempotent · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `agent` | `str` | required | The writing or reading agent; `'-'` or `'*'` means any agent where the op allows it. |
| `conversation_id` | `str` | required | The client's conversation id; this remains the thread id in Loom. |
| `message_id` | `str` | required | The client's stable message id. |
| `role` | `Literal['user', 'assistant']` | required | Only selectable user and assistant messages are embedded. |
| `content` | `str` | required | The message text; ignored when the transcript already holds the message. |
| `user_id` | `str` | required | The owner is a hard filter on the paired search operation. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `conversation_id` | `str` |  |
| `message_id` | `str` |  |
| `indexed` | `bool` | True when the turn is saved and has a vector the saved search ranks: a new write, a re-save (finishing what an interrupted save left behind), and a transcript turn that is now flagged saved. |
| `reason` | `Literal['', 'duplicate', 'owner_mismatch', 'deleted', 'unsupported_role', 'embed_failed', 'high_sensitivity']` | "duplicate": already saved, nothing changed. "owner_mismatch": the stored turn belongs to another user. "deleted": the stored turn was tombstoned. "unsupported_role": the stored turn is a system or tool turn, which is not embedded.… |
| `ts` | `datetime` | The stored turn's timestamp; the time of the refusal when one is refused. |

## `conversation.saved_status`

Which of a conversation's messages a user has saved, in one call: a chat client draws every message's saved state when it opens the conversation.

`POST /v1/conversation.saved_status` · MCP `loom_conversation_saved_status` · role `viewer` · read · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `agent` | `str` | required | The writing or reading agent; `'-'` or `'*'` means any agent where the op allows it. |
| `user_id` | `str` | required | The end user the row belongs to; `'-'` for none. |
| `conversation_id` | `str` | required | The conversation the messages belong to; message ids are unique within it. |
| `message_ids` | `list[str]` | required | The messages to check (1-500). |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `saved` | `list[str]` | The subset of `message_ids` this user has saved, in the order asked. |

## `conversation.search`

Rank conversation messages by embedding similarity to `query`.

`POST /v1/conversation.search` · MCP `loom_conversation_search` · role `viewer` · read · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `agent` | `str` | required | "*" or "-" searches every agent's turns; any other value, that one agent's. |
| `query` | `str` | required | Text matched against message content, by embedding similarity, or by substring when the embedder is unavailable. |
| `thread_id` | `str \| None` | `None` | optional: scope to one thread |
| `run_id` | `str \| None` | `None` | optional: filter by run_id; None or "-" = every run |
| `role` | `Literal['user', 'assistant', 'system', 'tool'] \| None` | `None` | Filter by speaker; system turns other than compaction summaries, and tool turns, are not embedded, so they match only on the substring fallback. |
| `user_id` | `str \| None` | `None` | Optional owner filter; None or "-" = every user. |
| `top_k` | `int` | `20` | At most this many hits (1-200). |
| `namespace_scope` | `Literal['this', 'all_mine']` | `'all_mine'` | "all_mine" also reads the caller's own namespaces, up to `memory_search_fanout_max_namespaces`, as knowledge.search does. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hits` | `list[_ConversationHit]` | Matching messages, most similar first and empty when none clears the similarity floor; newest first, with no floor, on the substring fallback. |
| `namespaces_skipped` | `list[str]` | Namespaces of the caller an all_mine search did not read because it stops at `memory_search_fanout_max_namespaces`; address one by name to search it. |

## `conversation.search_saved_messages`

Hybrid search over only the messages one user saved with conversation.save_message, not the whole transcript.

`POST /v1/conversation.search_saved_messages` · MCP `loom_conversation_search_saved_messages` · role `viewer` · read · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `agent` | `str` | required | The writing or reading agent; `'-'` or `'*'` means any agent where the op allows it. |
| `user_id` | `str` | required | The end user the row belongs to; `'-'` for none. |
| `query` | `str` | required |  |
| `conversation_id` | `str \| None` | `None` |  |
| `role` | `Literal['user', 'assistant'] \| None` | `None` |  |
| `top_k` | `int` | `20` |  |
| `search_mode` | `Literal['hybrid', 'semantic', 'lexical']` | `'hybrid'` | hybrid: the vector leg and a BM25 leg over each message's whole text, fused by reciprocal rank; semantic: vector only; lexical: BM25 only. |
| `lexical_weight` | `float` | `1.0` | Weight of the BM25 leg in the fusion (hybrid mode); 1.0 = equal weight. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hits` | `list[_SavedMessageHit]` |  |

## `conversation.set_logging`

Toggle whether this namespace records conversation transcripts.

`POST /v1/conversation.set_logging` · MCP `loom_conversation_set_logging` · role `admin` · idempotent · audited · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `enabled` | `bool` | required | True records transcripts in this namespace; False makes `append` store nothing. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `namespace` | `str` | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `enabled` | `bool` | The logging switch as it now stands. |

## `conversation.threads`

Recent conversation threads of a namespace, newest first.

`POST /v1/conversation.threads` · MCP `loom_conversation_threads` · role `viewer` · read

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `agent` | `str` | `'*'` | "*" or "-" lists every agent's threads |
| `window_days` | `int` | `30` | Only threads with a live message in the last this many days (1-365). |
| `limit` | `int` | `30` | At most this many threads (1-200). |
| `offset` | `int` | `0` | Threads to skip before the page (0-100,000); default 0, the first page. |
| `fields` | `list[str] \| None` | `None` | The output fields the caller reads (a whitelist resolved against the row model; an unknown name is a 422); unset, every field. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `threads` | `list[ConversationThreadSummary]` | Threads, most recently active first, each with its count and last message excerpt. |

## `conversation.unsave_message`

Withdraw one message from a user's saved-message search.

`POST /v1/conversation.unsave_message` · MCP `loom_conversation_unsave_message` · role `writer` · idempotent · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `agent` | `str` | required | The writing or reading agent; `'-'` or `'*'` means any agent where the op allows it. |
| `conversation_id` | `str` | required | The client's conversation id, as given to conversation.save_message. |
| `message_id` | `str` | required | The client's message id, as given to conversation.save_message. |
| `user_id` | `str` | required | Only this user's saved row is withdrawn. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `conversation_id` | `str` |  |
| `message_id` | `str` |  |
| `found` | `bool` | False when no saved row of this user exists: never saved, already withdrawn, or saved by another user (which is not confirmed). |
| `removed` | `bool` | True when the turn itself was removed: the namespace does not record transcripts, so the row existed only because of the save. |
| `ts` | `datetime` |  |

## `conversation.update`

Update one thread's title/metadata/run_id.

`POST /v1/conversation.update` · MCP `loom_conversation_update` · role `writer` · idempotent · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `agent` | `str` | required | The writing or reading agent; `'-'` or `'*'` means any agent where the op allows it. |
| `thread_id` | `str` | required | The thread to update; an unknown thread returns `updated=False`. |
| `title` | `str \| None` | `None` | Handler raises 400 if all three are absent (no-op signals a caller bug). |
| `metadata` | `dict[str, Any] \| None` | `None` | New metadata JSON, replacing the old object whole; None leaves it unchanged. |
| `run_id` | `str \| None` | `None` | The thread's new run; None or "-" leaves it unchanged, "" detaches it from its run. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `updated` | `bool` | False when the thread has no thread row (never created); nothing is written then. |
| `thread_id` | `str` | Echo of the input `thread_id`. |
| `updated_at` | `datetime \| None` | The new `updated_at` of the thread; None when nothing was updated. |
